description: Frozen golden vectors for the #151 sorted member Merkle tree over canonical #134 §8.1 member records. Leaf = BLAKE3(MEMBER_LEAF || canonical_record); parent = BLAKE3(MERKLE_NODE || left || right); trailing odd node promoted UNCHANGED (never duplicated); empty root = BLAKE3(MERKLE_NODE || empty bstr). Mirrors the Rust constants in ../member_sorted_merkle.rs; changing any value requires a schema bump and a protocol-change note.

schema_decisions.empty_bstr_note: #134 §8.2 names an empty bstr; under the deterministic-CBOR profile its complete encoding is the single byte 0x40.
schema_decisions.genesis_grant_seq_note: Administrators created by verified genesis use grant_seq = 0; post-genesis entries are 1-based.
schema_decisions.profile: optional opaque bstr carried by member.grant; omitted when absent

hash_formulas.odd_promotion: trailing unpaired node promoted byte-for-byte UNCHANGED to the next level (NOT duplicated, NOT hashed alone, NOT combined with an empty marker)

independent_verification.tool: blake3-ref (standalone Rust binary using the upstream `blake3` crate directly, NOT the implementation under test). Lives at /tmp/opencode/blake3-ref during fixture generation.
independent_verification.method: The 0/1/2/3-leaf roots and every leaf/intermediate hash below were recomputed by blake3-ref from the explicit canonical_hex bytes and the hash formulas above, independent of sorted.rs. They match the implementation byte-for-byte. The 10,000-leaf root is reproduced by the D6 full-build oracle (rebuild_root), an independent code path from the SortedMerkleMap incremental index; the generator asserted map==oracle at 10,000 leaves.

small_vectors.name: one-leaf-root-is-leaf-hash-v1
small_vectors.root_formula: L0 (single leaf promoted unchanged to the root)

small_vectors.name: three-leaves-odd-promotion-unchanged-v1
small_vectors.root_formula: node(node(L0,L1), L2) — L2 promoted UNCHANGED, NOT node(node(L0,L1), node(L2,L2))
small_vectors.wrong_duplicate_last_note: The duplicate-last interpretation hashes L2 with itself first; it MUST differ from the frozen root. This pins odd-node promotion as 'unchanged', not 'duplicate'.

large_vector_10000.name: ten-thousand-leaves-golden-root-v1
large_vector_10000.counter_endianness: big-endian u64 in identity bytes [0..8], bytes [8..32] zero-padded

sample_proof_counter_4567.note: 14 siblings = ceil(log2(10000)); odd promotions contribute no sibling step

large_vector_10000.oracle_agreement: The SortedMerkleMap incremental index and the D6 rebuild_root oracle agree byte-for-byte on the 10,000-leaf root (asserted at fixture-generation time).
large_vector_10000.build_time_note: Build time is hardware/profile-dependent and reported only by a dedicated release benchmark (#160 extends reporting). It is NOT a normal-CI assertion (spec §3.6 #57).

inclusion_proofs.spec: v2-crypto-core-crate.md §4 D7 / §8 Step 12 require inclusion-proof fixtures to be byte-pinned.
inclusion_proofs.independent_derivation: Each expected proof is HAND-DERIVED: sibling hashes are member_leaf_hash of the frozen canonical records above (reproducible with any BLAKE3 tool over the frozen iroh-room-v2/member-leaf domain), and sides/indices follow from the sorted-tree arithmetic — they are NOT read back from prove(). Cross-checks: leaf_hash(1) == the 1-leaf root; node(leaf1,leaf2) == the 2-leaf root (both already frozen). Exclusion is expressed as absence-of-proof for a non-member (prove() returns None) plus rebound-proof rejection, not as a separate byte fixture; see tests/member_sorted_merkle.rs::rebound_proof_for_absent_identity_rejects.

vectors.name: inclusion-proof-two-leaf-counter2-v1
vectors.derivation: counter=2 sits at sorted index 1 (odd) -> one Left sibling = leaf_hash(canonical_1) = the 1-leaf root.

vectors.name: inclusion-proof-three-leaf-counter2-v1
vectors.derivation: counter=2 at sorted index 1 (odd): level-0 Left sibling = leaf_hash(1); parent = node(leaf1,leaf2) moves to level-1 index 0 (even, has right neighbor) -> Right sibling = leaf_hash(3), promoted unchanged. Exercises both sides plus odd-node promotion.

vectors.name: inclusion-proof-three-leaf-counter3-v1
vectors.derivation: counter=3 at sorted index 2 (even, no right neighbor): trailing leaf promoted UNCHANGED to level 1 with no sibling step; at level 1 index 1 (odd) -> one Left sibling = node(leaf1,leaf2) = the 2-leaf root. Exercises a node-hash sibling produced by odd-node promotion.

change_log.note: Initial freeze of the #151 sorted member Merkle tree: canonical §8.1 record schema, deterministic-CBOR empty-bstr byte 0x40, sorted-by-raw-identity-key leaf order, exact odd-node 'promote unchanged' rule, and compact inclusion proofs. The legacy sparse 256-level map remains isolated for the #153 signed-record golden vectors and is not interoperable with these roots.

Added the frozen inclusion-proof fixture set (inclusion_proofs) closing the #153 / spec §4 D7 / §8 Step 12 'pin inclusion proof in vectors' requirement: three hand-derived, independently-reproducible canonical-CBOR inclusion proofs over the already-frozen 2- and 3-leaf trees (a leaf sibling on each side; a two-step path exercising both sides + odd-node promotion; and a node-hash sibling produced by trailing-leaf promotion). No frozen root or leaf hash changes — v2 only adds proof fixtures composed of already-frozen hashes. Exclusion remains expressed as absence-of-proof + rebound-proof rejection (no separate byte fixture).
